articles.title_en: Russia blocks Apple ID mobile top-ups amid App Store dispute
articles.lead_en: Russia blocked the option to top up Apple ID balances from mobile phone accounts at midnight on April 1, the Russian business daily Kommersant and the Russian Telegram news channel Ostorozhno Novosti confirmed.
